description: Source code for hardware layer handling trigger input signals, including input capture callbacks, pin configuration, and trigger processing for engine position sensors.

methods.name: cam_icu_width_callback
methods.description: Callback for camera ICU width event, increments VVT rise counter and handles VVT cam signal.

methods.name: cam_icu_period_callback
methods.description: Callback for camera ICU period event, increments VVT fall counter and handles VVT cam signal.

methods.name: shaft_icu_width_callback
methods.description: Callback for shaft ICU width event, determines primary/secondary trigger and handles shaft signal.

methods.name: shaft_icu_period_callback
methods.description: Callback for shaft ICU period event, determines primary/secondary trigger and handles shaft signal.

methods.name: turnOnTriggerInputPin
methods.description: Configures and starts ICU input capture on specified hardware pin.

methods.name: turnOffTriggerInputPin
methods.description: Stops ICU input capture on specified hardware pin.

methods.name: rememberPrimaryChannel
methods.description: Stores the primary trigger input capture driver.

methods.name: turnOnTriggerInputPins
methods.description: Enables trigger input pins based on current configuration.

methods.name: stopTriggerInputPins
methods.description: Disables all active trigger input pins.

methods.name: applyNewTriggerInputPins
methods.description: Reconfigures trigger input pins based on updated configuration.
